question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Eve and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) left midfielder
(C) striker
(D) right back
(E) center midfielder
(F) benchwarmer
(G) sweeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: cheerleader, left midfielder, striker, right back, center midfielder, benchwarmer, sweeper
1. Claire ↔ Dave: cheerleader, left midfielder, right back, striker, center midfielder, benchwarmer, sweeper
2. Bob ↔ Eve: cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, striker, left midfielder, benchwarmer, sweeper
3. Eve ↔ Dave: cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, sweeper
4. Claire ↔ Alice: right back, center midfielder, cheerleader, left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, sweeper
5. Claire ↔ Gertrude: right back, center midfielder, sweeper, left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, cheerleader
6. Dave ↔ Claire: right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, striker, benchwarmer, cheerleader
7. Eve ↔ Alice: striker, center midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, right back, benchwarmer, cheerleader
Claire is playing left midfielder, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
